## bod-p10–p11 — variety and non-knowledge In them variety extreme up-down across what; worlds, their parts, pleasure-pain-mind what. What of it non-knowledge — that its autonomy thus stated; it indeed saṃsāra of fools who is terrifying. Extreme variety in worlds, parts, and minds; non-knowledge of this autonomy is saṃsāra — the terrifying state of fools.

## bod-p12 (12) From that grace-sap or from teacher-scripture or from scripture of supreme Lord from which from which approached. // AgBpd_12
## bod-p12–p14 — attainment, liberation, and non-difference From that grace-sap or from teacher-scripture or from scripture of supreme Lord from which from which approached. What of reality full-knowledge — that is liberation from supreme Lord. That fullness of awakened, living-liberation that is remembered. These two bondage and liberation from supreme-Lord-nature. Not they differ; no difference indeed in truth in supreme Lord. Three paths to the reality (grace, teacher-scripture, Lord's scripture); full knowledge of reality = liberation = living liberation; bondage and liberation are not ultimately different in the Lord.
